'''Herbert Knoblich''' (11 June 1939 – 5 December 2021) was a German physicist and politician.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=13 December 2021|title=Herbert Knoblich gestorben|trans-title= |url=https://www.pnn.de/potsdam/abschied-vom-ersten-landtagspraesidenten-herbert-knoblich-gestorben/27887198.html|language=German|work=[[Potsdamer Neueste Nachrichten]]|location= |access-date=14 December 2021}}</ref> A member of the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany]], he served as president of the [[Landtag of Brandenburg]] from 1990 to 2004.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.parlamentsdokumentation.brandenburg.de/starweb/LBB/ELVIS/servlet.starweb?path=LBB/ELVIS/SAMTP.web&search=11900|title=Knoblich, Herbert Dr.|work=Landtag Brandenburg|language=German}}</ref>
